cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

mechanism: A corrects the scope and terminology of an honest account until the questioner can establish almost nothing about missing money.
confusable: D141 replaces information with warmth; D143 agrees to truth while progressively restricting its definition.
comparison: Financial accountability differs from a partner challenging a birthday meal story.
seedUse: Keep bank, contents and arrival distinctions but make the supposed expert actively correct the inquiry.
